notes.title: Worlds Adrift - Out Now in Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LD9TQzM.gif[/img]

After four years of development, and a boatload of anticipation, the world’s first Community-Crafted MMO, Worlds Adrift, begins its journey into Early Access today!

Created by Bossa Studios, the brains behind the acclaimed Surgeon Simulator and I am Bread, Worlds Adrift is our most ambitious game yet, offering an entirely user-generated environment, with a completely unscripted style of play. 

Previously in Closed Beta, Worlds Adrift today launches into Early Access and begins a new chapter in its development. 

To celebrate this milestone Worlds Adrift now includes a new culture - the Kioki Unity - and over 100 new islands from our Island Creator community.  For a quick preview of some of the new Kioki islands take a look at the GIF above!

Worlds Adrift will continue to evolve throughout Early Access, based on the extensive feedback you, our loyal band of Travellers, continue to provide.  To follow progress and receive the latest updates sign up to our [url=https://www.worldsadrift.com/]newsletter[/url] and follow our [url=https://www.worldsadrift.com/roadmap/]Roadmap.[/url]

See you in the Skies!

[b]EXPLORE. BUILD. UNITE.[/b]

Worlds Adrift  is launching with the latest build, 0.2.0, updates include:
[list]
[*]Additional servers for both US and EU regions
[*]The world has been wiped, and will launch with a brand new layout with brand new islands
[*]The new world is now separated into two diverse cultural regions; Saborian and Kioki, the [*]latter bringing with it all-new music and assets
[*]Numerous new clothing items from Sabor, Bandinia, Ishgiru, Karem, Pin
[*]A brand new in-game feedback form
[*]Multiple bug fixes
[*]Probably new ones...
[*]VFX and SFX improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Worlds Adrift EA Launch - World’s First Live Stream in the SKY!
notes.content:
[img]https://imgur.com/Ctwok5k.gif[/img]

Join the Worlds Adrift team and a group of brave explorers as we soar up to 150ft in the air for an exciting launch day stream from 12pm - 6pm BST... on the deck of a sky ship brought to life!

In a World’s first (the real world that is), Bossa and friends will be celebrating the launch of Worlds Adrift by streaming the game suspended high over the beautiful London skyline.
Coming out of Closed Beta, Worlds Adrift launches into Early Access and begins a new chapter in its story. 

Watch here it LIVE here:  [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bossastudios]Twitch.tv/BossaStudios[/url]

notes.title: Takich wiadomości powinno być więcej na Steamie. Jesteście gotowi? Mamy ZUPEŁNIE NOWĄ i DARMOWĄ aktualizację dla wszystkich posiadaczy Surgeon Simulator: Anniversary Edition! Juhu!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.bossastudios.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/Trump-gif-1.gif[/img]

Takich wiadomości powinno być więcej na Steamie. Jesteście gotowi? Mamy ZUPEŁNIE NOWĄ i DARMOWĄ aktualizację dla wszystkich posiadaczy Surgeon Simulator: Anniversary Edition! Juhu! 

Posiadacie tylko podstawową wersję gry Surgeon Simulator 2013? Nie przejmujcie się! Trwa promocja na zawartość do pobrania z Anniversary Edition, więc możecie zdobyć wszystkie pozostała poziomy (łącznie z najnowszym) za grosze. Robimy to wszystko z miłości do was.

Chcecie wiedzieć, co dla was przygotowaliśmy?

Donald Trump – człowiek roku? Nieważne, czy go kochacie, czy nienawidzicie, nie można przejść obok niego obojętnie a teraz będziecie mieli okazję go operować! Inspirowaliśmy się najgłośniejszym tegorocznym wydarzeniem politycznym, czyli wyborami w USA i was również zapraszamy do oddania głosu w naszej  [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/317960/] DARMOWEJ aktualizacji gry Surgeon Simulator: Anniversary Edition[/url] na Steamie. Zdecydujcie: czy Donald Trump to złoczyńca o sercu z kamienia czy bohater o złotym sercu?

„Wnętrze Donalda Trumpa” pozwoli wam wcielić się w rolę wybitnego chirurga, który musi uratować życie pana Trumpa i transplantować jego popsute serce – ale czy da mu nowe, złote serce czy serce z kamienia? WYBÓR NALEŻY DO WAS! Do waszej dyspozycji oddamy wiele nowych profesjonalnych narzędzi medycznych, które pomogą wam w przeprowadzeniu tej operacji. Będziecie mogli znieczulić pana Trumpa wykorzystując wódkę Trump Vodka, robić mu łagodzące okłady ze steków Trump Steak lub wykorzystać inne „trumpowe” rekwizyty.

Wasze wybory dotyczące tego, czy podarować panu Trumpowi złote serce, czy też serce z kamienia będzie można śledzić na żywo [url=http://www.surgeonsim.com/trump/]na naszej stronie internetowej[/url].

Jeśli jeszcze wam mało, dołączamy też specjalny zestaw do makijażu, który pozwoli zaprezentować ukryty urok pana Trumpa.

WSPÓLNIE PRZEPROWADZIMY DOBRĄ ZMIANĘ W SERCU DONALDA TRUMPA!

Pozdrawiamy,

Zespół Surgeon Simulator 

x o x o

notes.title: MAKING SURGERY GREAT AGAIN! (FREE DLC for SURGEON SIMULATOR A&E OWNERS)
notes.content:
[img]http://www.bossastudios.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/Trump-gif-1.gif[/img]

This is the best kind of Steam announcement. Are you ready? We have a BRAND NEW and FREE update for everyone who owns Surgeon Simulator: Anniversary Edition! Woohoo! (not this game, the non VR one).

Only own Surgeon Simulator 2013? Don’t worry! The Anniversary Edition DLC is on sale at the moment so you can get all of the other levels (eyes, teeth, THIS) for mere pennies (or cents if you live across the water), just because we love you.

So what do we have in store for you?

Donald Trump - man of the moment? Love him or loathe him, you cannot ignore him, and now, you get to operate on him! Inspired by this year's most talked about political event, we invite you to cast your vote in our [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/317960/] FREE update for Surgeon Simulator: Anniversary Edition[/url] on Steam. Make your choice, Donald Trump: stone-hearted villain, or gold-hearted hero?

‘Inside Donald Trump’ allows you to step into the hands of a master surgeon, dedicated to saving Mr Trump’s life by replacing his ailing heart - but will you replace it with a heart of gold, or a heart of stone? THE CHOICE IS YOURS! There are lots of new professional-grade medical tools to help you with your surgery; you can ease Donald's medicated sleep using Trump Vodka, gently caress him with a meaty Trump Steak or loosen his organs with the Trump Tower, plus a few other Trump-related surprises (some of them involving hands).

The live vote of how many of you have chosen to award Donald a heart of gold vs a heart of stone will be tracked via the nifty swingometer, [url=http://www.surgeonsim.com/trump/]RIGHT HERE ON THE WEBSITE [/url], just like in a real election.

If that wasn’t enough, we have included a special make-up kit so you can unlock Donald’s hidden glamour.

TOGETHER WE CAN MAKE SURGERY GREAT AGAIN!


Lots of love,

The Surgeon Simulator Team 

x o x o

notes.title: Bug Fixes - round 1
notes.content:
Hey there, VR surgeons.

We’ve just updated the experience with a few little bug fixes that we discovered since the release yesterday. Quick, aren’t we? =D

Here’s what has changed:

Archimedes’ (the bird) cute little chirrup was cutting off abruptly. Now when you throw things at him, his dulcet tones are much more pleasing.

As in real life, hitting The Heavy’s head or groin causes a lot more damage than other body parts - PLUS -  there is now visible damage to the blood bag, so you can see how much you’re hurting him.

There is a quicker balloon pop effect, so the confetti now showers you in a more pleasing fashion. No-one likes slow confetti.

You couldn’t pick up balloons before after they fell from the ceiling. Now you can, so that’s 100% more party-while-you-play.

There was a strange seam between The Heavy’s torso and legs after healing him. That’s now fixed, and he looks splendid.

When you win, the jingle should play correctly so you know when to celebrate.

That’s all for now. Any bugs you find (fingers crossed - NONE!) should be reported to surgeonfeedback@bossastudios.com.

Love and kisses,

The Surgeon Simulator Team

notes.title: Meet The Medic is Now Available on HTC Vive!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/MuSoZ7I.gif[/img]

It's been a long time coming, but Surgeon Simulator has finally made its virtual reality debut with HTC Vive and Team Fortress 2, with Surgeon Simulator VR: Meet The Medic.

This is a taster of what's to come from Bossa Studios on VR as Surgeon Simulator will be coming to other VR platform, later this year.

If you haven't seen the trailer for the game, check it out here!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DH_zN0hF1s0

As well as that, here's a demo of what you'll look like while playing Surgeon Simulator VR: Meet The Medic!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7EVzAXraqbM

If you've picked up a Vive, let us know what you think of virtual reality!

Cheers!
